summary.headline: Very high profits and all nine financial-strength checks passed
summary.takeaway: Apple turns sales and invested money into profit far better than similar companies, and its finances improved on every Piotroski check. Watch the thin short-term cash cushion and the part of ROE that comes from debt.

positives.text: Keeps about $27.60 of every $100 in sales as profit (net margin 27.6%), far above the peer median of 7.15%.
ROE (profit compared with shareholders' money) is 142% versus a peer median of 73.6%. ROIC (return on all invested money) is 98.3%.
Piotroski score (nine checks of financial strength) is 9 of 9. Margins, cash flow and leverage all improved.

watch_outs.text: Current ratio (short-term assets compared with bills due within a year) is 1.02, and quick ratio is 0.938. That is a thin cushion.
Equity multiplier is 4.11x (assets compared with shareholders' money). The very high ROE partly reflects borrowing and a small equity base.
Net debt (debt minus cash) is $21.4 billion. Debt to EBITDA (debt compared with yearly operating earnings) is a low 0.456x.

what_to_watch_next: Next earnings report on 29 Jan 2027: check whether net margin stays near 27.6%.
Whether the current ratio keeps rising from 1.02, after improving from 0.89.
summary.ask_yourself: How much does a company's short-term cash cushion matter to you compared with its profit strength?

It also provides advertising services comprising third-party licensing arrangements and own advertising platforms; AppleCare and cloud services; and payment services, including Apple Card and Apple Pay. In addition, the company operates App Store that allow customers to discover and download applications and digital content, such as books, music, video, games, and podcasts. Further, it provides digital content through subscription-based services, including Apple Arcade, a game service; Apple Fitness+, a personalized fitness service; Apple Music, which offers users a curated listening experience; Apple News+, a news and magazine service; and Apple TV, which offers original content and live sports. The company sells its products and resells third-party products through its retail and online stores, and direct sales force; its services through its various service platforms; and third-party cellular network carriers and other resellers. It serves consumer, small and mid-sized business, education, enterprise, and government markets. The company operates in North and South America, European countries, India, the Middle East, Africa, China mainland, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, and rest of Asia. The company was formerly known as Apple Computer, Inc. and changed its name to Apple Inc. in January 2007. Apple Inc. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Cupertino, California.

payload.description: Tesla, Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, leases, and sells electric vehicles, and energy generation and storage systems in the United States, China, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Automotive; and Energy Generation and Storage. The company offers electric vehicles, as well as sells automotive regulatory credits; and non-warranty maintenance services and collision, automotive insurance services, as well as part sales and retail merchandise sale. It also provides sedans and sport utility vehicles through direct and used vehicle sales, a network of Tesla Superchargers, and in-app upgrades; purchase financing and leasing services; services for electric vehicles through its company-owned service locations and Tesla mobile service technicians; and vehicle limited warranties and extended service plans. In addition, the company engages in the design, manufacture, installation, sale, and leasing of solar energy generation and energy storage products, and related services to residential, commercial, and industrial customers and utilities through its website, stores, and galleries, as well as through a network of channel partners. Further, it provides services and repairs to its energy product customers, including under warranty and extended service plans; and various financing options to its residential customers; lithium-ion battery energy storage products, such as Powerwall and Megapack; energy generation products, including solar panels and solar roof; self-driving development and artificial intelligence software, vehicle control and infotainment software, and battery and powertrain. The company was formerly known as Tesla Motors, Inc. and changed its name to Tesla, Inc. in February 2017. Tesla, Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.

positives.text: Laporan kuartalan (10-Q) terbaru terbit 22 Okt 2026, sehari setelah rilis hasil laba pada 21 Okt 2026.
Dokumen rapat pemegang saham (DEF 14A) terbit 19 Okt 2026, sehingga informasi resmi rapat tersedia bagi pemegang saham.

watch_outs.text: Judul 25 Nov 2026 menyebut Tesla memangkas memori 25% karena krisis chip akibat AI, dan saham TSLA melemah di perdagangan malam.
Merger masih berupa pembicaraan. Judul 24 Nov 2026 menyebut satu kelompok investor punya alasan khawatir, judul lain menyebut ada catatan mengejutkan.
Judul 25 Nov 2026 menyebut BYD berencana memproduksi mobil di Prancis untuk memperkuat dorongannya ke pasar Eropa.

what_to_watch_next: Laporan laba Tesla berikutnya dijadwalkan pada 28 Jan 2027.
Kabar resmi soal merger Tesla-SpaceX: satu judul menyebut kesepakatan bisa datang Desember, sementara RBC memperkirakan pengumuman paling lambat awal 2027.
summary.ask_yourself: Seberapa nyaman Anda jika arah bisnis perusahaan bisa berubah besar akibat merger?
data_gaps: Hanya judul berita yang tersedia, isi artikel tidak ada, sehingga detail dan kebenaran tiap judul tidak bisa dicek.
Beberapa judul tidak terkait langsung dengan Tesla, misalnya soal AppLovin, Solana, pemasok tenaga surya, dan toko kulit di Stark County.
Detail transaksi orang dalam (Form 4, 9 Sep 2026 dan 17 Jun 2026) tidak tersedia, termasuk arah dan jumlah transaksinya.
Isi laporan 8-K tanggal 29 Sep 2026 (berita perusahaan) tidak dijelaskan dalam data.

summary.headline: Earns more on shareholder money than peers, but cash flow checks weak
summary.takeaway: JPMorgan turns shareholder money and sales into profit better than similar banks. Health checks are mixed: the Piotroski score is low, and many standard debt tests do not apply to banks.

positives.text: ROE (profit made from shareholders' money) is 18%, well above the peer median of 11.1%.
Keeps about $32.50 of every $100 in revenue as profit, more than similar banks (peer median 27.8%).
Share count fell from 2.88B to 2.78B, so each remaining share owns a slightly bigger part of the company.

watch_outs.text: Piotroski score (checks of financial strength) is 3 of 7, passing fewer than half of the checks that could be measured.
Operating cash flow was -$147.78B while net profit was $57.05B, so reported profit did not show up as cash.
Equity multiplier is 13.2x (assets compared with shareholder money). ROA (profit compared with assets) is 1.37%, down slightly from 1.5%.

what_to_watch_next: Next earnings report on 14 Jan 2027: watch whether operating cash flow turns positive.
Whether ROA holds near 1.4% or keeps slipping from 1.5%.
summary.ask_yourself: How comfortable are you with a company that uses a lot of borrowed money to earn its profits?
data_gaps: Altman Z-score is not used for banks, so there is no bankruptcy-risk score.
Debt to equity, net debt, interest coverage and current ratio are not meaningful for banks.
ROIC and gross margin do not apply to banks; operating margin is missing.
Only 7 of 9 Piotroski checks could be measured.
No history comparison for ROE or net margin, only peer medians.

summary.headline: Pendapatan dan laba terus tumbuh, kas jauh melebihi utang
summary.takeaway: Pendapatan JPM tumbuh rata-rata 12.3% per tahun selama 3 tahun, dan laba ikut naik. Margin laba bersih naik-turun di sekitar 31%, sementara kas jauh lebih besar dari total utang.

positives.text: Pendapatan naik 8.1% dibanding tahun lalu, dan EPS (laba per saham) naik 9.9%. Rata-rata pertumbuhan pendapatan 3 tahun 12.3% per tahun.
Margin laba bersih tahunan naik dari 29.3% (FY2022) menjadi 31.3% (FY2025). Artinya bagian pendapatan yang menjadi laba makin besar.
Kas Rp5,970 triliun jauh di atas total utang Rp1,310 triliun pada Q3 FY26, sehingga ada kas bersih Rp4,670 triliun.

watch_outs.text: Q2 FY26 melonjak: pendapatan Rp1,050 triliun (naik 27.7%) dan margin 36.9%. Di Q3 FY26 margin kembali ke 30.5%.
Laba bersih FY2025 turun ke Rp1,040 triliun dari Rp1,070 triliun, dan margin turun ke 31.3% dari 32.9% di FY2024.
Arus kas operasi sangat naik-turun, misalnya minus Rp3,880 triliun di Q1 FY26. Bagi bank, angka ini dipengaruhi arus pinjaman dan simpanan.

what_to_watch_next: Laporan keuangan berikutnya pada 14 Jan 2027: apakah margin laba bersih tetap di sekitar 30.5% atau berubah lagi.
Apakah lonjakan pendapatan seperti Q2 FY26 (Rp1,050 triliun) terulang, atau pendapatan tetap di kisaran Rp919 triliun per kuartal.

payload.description: Plug Power Inc. designs, develops, and sells hydrogen products and solutions in Europe, Australia, North America, and internationally. The company offers GenDrive, a hydrogen fueled PEM fuel cell system, which powers material handling EVs, including Class 1, 2, 3 and 6 electric forklifts, automated guided vehicles, and ground support equipment; GenFuel, a liquid hydrogen fueling, delivery, generation, storage, and dispensing system; and GenCare, an Internet of Things based maintenance and on-site service program. It also provides GenKey, a turn-key solution; GenEco electrolyzers for clean hydrogen production; liquefaction systems; cryogenic equipment, such as trailers and mobile storage equipment for the distribution of liquified hydrogen, oxygen, argon, nitrogen, and other cryogenic gases; GenSure, a stationary fuel cell solution; and liquid hydrogen. The company serves customers in material handling operations, fuel cell electric vehicle fleets, and stationary power applications through its direct sales force, original equipment manufacturers, and dealer networks. Plug Power Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Slingerlands, New York.

output.headline: Laba Q3 positif, tapi kas terus terkuras dan margin operasi negatif
output.takeaway: Pendapatan naik 13.3% dari tahun lalu, dan Q3 FY26 mencatat laba bersih positif. Namun bisnis inti masih rugi, arus kas tetap negatif, dan kas turun dari Rp6.75 triliun ke Rp2.46 triliun sejak Q4 FY25.

positives.text: Pendapatan Q3 FY26 sebesar Rp3.67 triliun, naik 13.3% dibanding kuartal yang sama tahun lalu.
Margin operasi (laba usaha dibanding penjualan) membaik ke -37.5% di Q3 FY26, dari -197% di Q3 FY25.
Arus kas bebas (kas sisa setelah belanja modal) minus Rp1.46 triliun di Q3 FY26, lebih kecil dari minus Rp4.22 triliun di Q2 FY25.

watch_outs.text: Laba bersih Rp1.83 triliun di Q3 FY26 tidak didukung kas: arus kas operasi masih minus Rp1.4 triliun, margin kotor -2.67%.
Kas turun dari Rp6.75 triliun (Q4 FY25) ke Rp2.46 triliun (Q3 FY26). Arus kas bebas negatif di setiap kuartal dalam data.
Pertumbuhan jangka panjang tipis: pendapatan rata-rata hanya naik 0.401% per tahun selama 3 tahun. Rugi bersih FY2025 masih Rp29.9 triliun.

what_to_watch_next: Laporan keuangan berikutnya pada 1 Mar 2027: apakah laba positif berlanjut dan arus kas operasi membaik.
Posisi kas, terakhir Rp2.46 triliun di Q3 FY26, dibanding arus kas bebas yang masih minus.
